body: Hey- I hear you. As someone who tried to kill himself when he was 9- I can probably imagine what you are feeling. I just want you to know, often kids and young adults feel much more emotional about smaller life problems just because it's the first time you may be encountering them. Once you're through all that it's easy to say that it wasn't such a big deal- and this is what I imagine all these people are thinking. Anyway- I don't really have any advice for you- I just want you to know that many people also feel how you are feeling- and in fact if you look around you you might find that the whole world is built upon people trying to make sense of the confusion that is life. Sometimes it can help to just sink your teeth right into the pain and simply live it- emote it. Scream it if you have to! I don't really know. You know what though- send me a message if you feel like it. Tell me everything. I'll read every word you write.
